_comment: Core MCP is deliberately absent. Everything it does, `fab` does, and `fab` does more -
including git integration and job execution, which Core MCP does not expose at all.
Local MCP is kept for knowledge only, and the args below are what make that structural
rather than a rule anyone has to follow. Measured against Fabric.Mcp.Server 1.4.0 by
handshaking with it and calling tools/list - not from the docs, which are wrong here:
--mode namespace               0 tools  (the documented default; exposes nothing)
The single `docs` tool routes to all six documentation tools: api-examples,
That is the whole reason this server is here - writing a correct .platform and item
definition from scratch instead of guessing. Nothing else from this server is wanted,
and with this scoping nothing else is even loaded.
